source.name: dnata media centre, dnata nets three-year deal with Dubai Basketball as Founding Partner
source.quote: dnata's branding will appear on Dubai Basketball's official jerseys, across the Coca-Cola Arena home court
source.note: Three-year Founding Partner (2025-26 to 2027-28). dnata wordmark front-centre on the 2026/27 home jersey in the club's kit-launch and official store photos.

source.name: Dubai Basketball: Dubai Basketball and Mr. Eight Development Announce Three-Year Exclusive Partnership
source.quote: the Mr. Eight brand will feature on Dubai Basketball's game jerseys throughout the club's EuroLeague and ABA League campaigns
source.note: MR.EIGHT BRANDED RESIDENCES on the upper right chest of the 2026/27 home jersey in the club's kit-launch and official store photos.

source.name: Equiti: Equiti signs as founding partner of Dubai Basketball ahead of EuroLeague debut
source.quote: Equiti will feature prominently on official jerseys and courtside at the Coca-Cola Arena
source.note: Founding Partner and Official Digital Wealth Partner for three seasons from 2025-26. equiti logo on the back of the 2026/27 home jersey, between the player name and number, in the club's official store photos.

source.name: Dubai Basketball: Audi, Al Nabooda Automobiles Powers Dubai Basketball's Season with Strategic Partnership
source.quote: Audi, Al Nabooda Automobiles proudly announces its strategic partnership with Dubai Basketball as the teams' Official Automotive Partner
source.note: Three-season deal from 2025-26. Audi rings logo on the lower left leg of the shorts in the club's 2026/27 kit-launch and official store photos.

summary: 2026/27 adidas home kit ('Made to Belong', unveiled 12 Sep 2026): dnata front; Mr. Eight Branded Residences upper-chest patch; Equiti on the back above the number; Audi (Al Nabooda) on the shorts. The upper-left chest carries the league-wide EuroLeague/Etihad partner mark (see the euroleague-etihad deal), not a club sponsor. DET/Visit Dubai, on the back in 2024-25 and 2025-26, no longer appears.
